chunks.text: Almamlaka TV is launching a new initiative called the Digital Expansion Initiative (DEI), aimed at modernizing the channel's digital presence across streaming, mobile, and social platforms. This document outlines the project's scope, goals, and key stakeholders.
chunks.embed_text:
Project Overview Document › §1 Introduction
Almamlaka TV is launching a new initiative called the Digital Expansion Initiative (DEI), aimed at modernizing the channel's digital presence across streaming, mobile, and social platforms. This document outlines the project's scope, goals, and key stakeholders.

chunks.text: The primary goal of the DEI is to increase digital viewership by 40% within the first year of launch. Secondary goals include improving content discoverability, modernizing the mobile application, and establishing a unified content management system across all platforms.
chunks.embed_text:
Project Overview Document › §2 Project Goals
The primary goal of the DEI is to increase digital viewership by 40% within the first year of launch. Secondary goals include improving content discoverability, modernizing the mobile application, and establishing a unified content management system across all platforms.

Project Overview Document › §3 Key Details
Project Lead: Sara Al-Rashid

Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000

Planned Launch Date: March 15, 2027

Project Duration: 14 months

chunks.text:
The initiative covers three main platforms: the Almamlaka TV mobile application (iOS and Android), the web streaming portal, and integration with third-party smart TV platforms. Each platform will receive a redesigned user interface aligned with the updated Almamlaka TV brand guidelines.

As part of the accessibility improvements, the mobile application will support content and subtitles in 12 languages, including Arabic, English, French, and Spanish, with plans to expand to additional languages in future phases.
chunks.embed_text:
Project Overview Document › §4 Platform Scope
The initiative covers three main platforms: the Almamlaka TV mobile application (iOS and Android), the web streaming portal, and integration with third-party smart TV platforms. Each platform will receive a redesigned user interface aligned with the updated Almamlaka TV brand guidelines.

As part of the accessibility improvements, the mobile application will support content and subtitles in 12 languages, including Arabic, English, French, and Spanish, with plans to expand to additional languages in future phases.

chunks.text: The project is sponsored by the Almamlaka TV Digital Strategy Department and overseen by a steering committee consisting of representatives from Engineering, Content, Marketing, and Legal & Compliance.
chunks.embed_text:
Project Overview Document › §5 Stakeholders
The project is sponsored by the Almamlaka TV Digital Strategy Department and overseen by a steering committee consisting of representatives from Engineering, Content, Marketing, and Legal & Compliance.

chunks.text: Success will be measured through monthly active users (MAU), average session duration, app store ratings, and content engagement rates. A quarterly review will be conducted by the steering committee to track progress against these metrics.
chunks.embed_text:
Project Overview Document › §6 Success Metrics
Success will be measured through monthly active users (MAU), average session duration, app store ratings, and content engagement rates. A quarterly review will be conducted by the steering committee to track progress against these metrics.

chunks.text: All user data collected through the mobile application and streaming portal will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. User data will not be shared with third parties without explicit consent, except where required by law.

Team & Governance Document › §4 Data Privacy Policy
All user data collected through the mobile application and streaming portal will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. User data will not be shared with third parties without explicit consent, except where required by law.

chunks.text: User-generated comments and interactions on the platform are subject to Almamlaka TV's content moderation guidelines. Content that violates community standards will be removed, and repeat violations may result in account suspension.
